add.event: SKOP多次依赖芬兰银行隔夜借款维持流动性
add.evidence: On several occasions during 1990, SKOP had to resort to overnight debt from the Bank of Finland to cover its liquidity position

add.event: 政府向银行提供71亿马克（12亿欧元）初期零息可转换贷款
add.evidence: In 1992, to stabilize the financial sector and to prevent a credit crunch, the government gave a 7.1 billion markka (€1.2 billion), initially zero-interest, convertible loan to Finnish banks.

add.event: 两大商业银行合并为Merita银行（后为Nordea）
add.evidence: The two largest Finnish commercial banks, Suomen Yhdyspankki and Kansallis-Osake-Pankki, merged in 1995 to become Merita Bank, later Nordea.
